messages:
Anika: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1 - we need concrete owners for the rollout/canary improvements (auto-rollback, blast-radius limits, recurring patterns). TL;DR your owner + ETA here.

Vik: I'll own auto-rollback implementation and audit events. ETA: 2026-04-09 for staging PR, 2026-04-16 for canary in prod. Blocker: need schema signoff for `rollback_policy`.

Rowan: I'll take feature-flag blast-radius + region scoping (frontend + API). Proposal by 2026-03-28, schema PR by 2026-04-05.

Anika: Please include who runs the first 3 canaries and who owns post-rollback triage in the ticket.

Vik: Rollback policy sketch: ```json
{"policy":"auto_rollback","enabled":true,"min_requests":200,"failure_rate_pct":1.5,"p95_delta_ms":50,"window_sec":300,"consecutive_windows":2,"max_blast_radius_pct":3}```

Rowan: Flag gating sketch (yaml):
```yaml
flag: async_encoder_v3
stages:
  - pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
  - pct: 5
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
  - pct: 20
    regions: all
safety:
  min_requests: 300
  auto_rollback: true
  max_blast_radius_pct: 5
```

QA: Require automated smoke tests for each canary stage (correctness + latency). We'll add pipeline jobs for staging.

sre-bot: Deploy window: 2026-04-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Add `pre-deploy-checklist` and `deployment-checklist` labels to PRs.

Anika: Tracking tickets: PM-8201 -> Vik (rollback), PM-8202 -> Rowan (flag gating). Put ETAs and PR links in tickets.

Vik: Created PM-8201: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-8201. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3122 (WIP). Will add telemetry schema to the ticket.

Rowan: Created PM-8202 and uploaded proposal doc (WIP).

Liam: Ops note: ensure rollback emits `rollback.triggered` with route, variant_from, variant_to, reason, metrics_snapshot, sample_size, trigger_type. Retain 90d and index route+variant. Also add a UI switch to pause auto-rollback for maintenance windows (audit-logged).

Vik: Will emit event and include `trigger_type` enum. Adding retention to PM-8201.

Rowan: Adding UI toggle to PM-8202. Will include region-scoping controls and max blast radius enforcement in the API.

Anika: Acceptance criteria for a canary stage: sample_size >= min_requests AND (error_rate < threshold AND p95 <= baseline + delta). If sample_size insufficient mark stage as `insufficient_data` and require human review.

QA: We'll attach smoke tests to the staging pipeline and run 3 dry canaries with SRE before prod.

Anika: Thanks. Please paste ticket+PR links here when available. I'll review progress in the ops sync on 2026-04-12 and escalate any slips. :white_check_mark:
